title: Unbounded nonconvex Young differential inclusions: existence of a measurable selection of solutions
summary: We study the differential inclusion $\text{d}z_t\in F(z_t)\text{d}x_t$, with initial condition $z_0=ξ$, where $F$ is a nonconvex-valued multifunction, and $x$ a path of bounded $q$-variation, for some $1\leqslant q 1/γ$ and $ξ\in F(0)$, a selection $f(ξ)$ of bounded $p$-variation, started at $ξ$, such that $f$ is measurable in $ξ$.
